notes.title: Halloween Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone!
[/h2]

Happy Halloween, we hope you’re all enjoying The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication! 
 
Today is an exciting day as we officially launch the game on consoles, and we’re bringing this patch to the PC version to ensure it’s in line with the console release. This update focuses on improving the overall gameplay experience, fixing some minor bugs, and introducing a few quality-of-life tweaks.

[h3][b]Patch Highlights for Update Ver.1.7.2[/b][/h3]

[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the video codec.
[/list]
[b]Optimisation[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the spatial perception of the voice and sound effects.
[*] Updated the game's credits.
[*] Optimised multiple UI button prompts.
[*] Optimised Localisation for several languages.
[*] Optimised memory usage for textures.
[/list]
[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error where the master tape became uninteractive after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed an error where 'The Dark One' did not see A-Hai in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where videos would play before being revealed properly.
[*] Fixed subtitles that were not properly closed during calls.
[/list]
We’re committed to making The Bridge Curse 2 the best experience possible, so keep your feedback coming! Let us know how you’re finding the game.

Thanks for your continued support and Happy Halloween! 

— The Bridge Curse 2 Team

notes.title: RESOLVED: Patch to solve the black screen issue now live
notes.notes:
A patch is now live, resolving the black screen start-up issue!

Players, please update the game to v1.6.3, which will solve the black screen problem.

We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to players.

We are currently continuing to resolve audio and voice issues, thank you very much for your patience and understanding.


We've identified a launch issue affecting a small subset of players booting The Bridge Curse 2: The Extraction. Rest assured, we're actively developing a patch to resolve this promptly.

In the interim, to get you back into the game smoothly, we recommend trying these troubleshooting steps. 

For a quick fix, many players have found success by downloading and installing the VP9 Video Extensions available on the Microsoft Store.

Additionally, consider these options:

1. If you have third-party video player software installed, we advise either uninstalling it or disabling it temporarily.

2. For Windows 10 users, ensure your system is updated to at least version 1809.

3. If your computer has both an independent GPU and a built-in GPU, we recommend disabling the one not in use currently.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to resolve this.

notes.title: Survive The Night In 'The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication', Out Now On Steam!
notes.notes:
We are extremely excited to announce that The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication' is out now on Steam! PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, GOG, and Epic Games Store coming later this year.

[h3]Buy now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331330/The_Bridge_Curse_2_The_Extrication/

Try to escape with your life in a first-person survival horror adventure set within 'Wen Hua University', renowned in Taiwan for its ghost tales & folklore. Play through the eyes of four distinct characters as you evade and confront terrifying ghosts, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and unearth a sinister conspiracy... Will you survive the night, or become the latest victim of the curse? 

[b]Class Is In Session...[/b] Intent on resurrecting a decades-old campus ghost story, a daring group of film club students orchestrates the 'Carnival of Horror ' within the infamously haunted 'Da Ren' building. As they begin to film, the line between fiction and reality blurs, and inexplicable events begin to unfold…. 

[b]Outwit and Evade Relentless Pursuers:[/b] Formidable ghosts lurk in the shadow-drenched halls of Wen Hua. Stifle every gasp, swallow every whimper as the labyrinthine halls amplify every sound. Confront or divert your stalker's attention as you desperately try and survive the night. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/9823e2e557ef6c37509aa25841ab889782058b16.png[/img]

[b]A Memorable Cast of Characters:[/b] Play as four distinct characters and encounter memorable personalities as you navigate through each perspective, from the hilariously bizarre 'Sergeant Huang' to the bone-chillingly sinister presence of the 'Mad Ballerina'. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/11c6e36944c26a27f8ebc2b7782bab031c9a0c5f.png[/img]

[b]Explore a Harrowing Campus:[/b] Traverse winding corridors and navigate through a labyrinth of rooms in a beautifully realised Taiwanese university. Utilise the school map to uncover hidden pathways and escape routes while confronting the relentless terrors of your haunting stalkers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/1729973b623c9d7529c649d28f320892c0c2642c.png[/img]

[b]Solve Mind-Bending Puzzles & Unravel a Chilling Conspiracy: [/b]Gather cryptic clues, unearthing artifacts and items scattered throughout the campus bringing you deeper into the hidden conspiracies rooted within Wen Hua.
Out now on Steam! 

PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, GOG and Epic Games Store coming later this year.

notes.title: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication Demo Releases 10/9
notes.notes:
The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication, the latest installment in the horror game series, was recently showcased at Taipei's Summer Game Expo in July. Developed by Softstar and based on The Bridge Curse film, the demo featured there gave players a chance to experience two levels of the game first-hand. The line to play seemed to never end, and the game received extensive positive feedback and praise. The development team has stated that the game will participate in Steam's Next Fest this October. The demo will be available for download at 10:00 AM Pacific Time on October 9th. They invite players from around the world to try out The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication to get a freaky peek at the spooky storyline and exciting gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/e6ecd2266c9c19334ae086d790776167cbe78739.png[/img]

The sequel's story centers around a real campus ghost story, with the player controlling four characters during Wen Hua University's "Carnival of Horror," experiencing the ensuing terror from a variety of perspectives. To respond to the enthusiasm from players all over the world, the devs have prepared an amazing demo, which is sure to satisfy that yearning for horror. Just head to the Steam store and download the demo to play two full, incredible levels featuring never-before-seen storylines and puzzles, with a game time of approximately 1 hour. The content featured in the demo is the prologue to The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication. Our story begins when a journalist receives an eerie letter and heads up to Wen Hua University alone to unravel the mystery of its contents. Is the military instructor she encounters a friend or foe? What eyes lie behind those thick, black glasses...? The player must painstakingly piece together the history of a haunted building, built with wicked geomancy in mind. Carry a mysterious oil lamp with even stranger powers, and don't get caught... by the headless woman! All this exciting content is crucial to the sequel's story and can be experienced in the Steam demo.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/2985f7c6a55bd670a11afe491e2499672a15600c.png[/img]

Besides continuing with the creepy, freaky vibes of the first game in the series, the development team has also heeded the calls of players, balancing the intense pressure of pursuit scenes and adding in more diverse types of gameplay. And we'd be remiss to not mention the exceptional upgrade in visual quality. Each character's features are masterfully highlighted, and the monsters and ghouls are absolutely stunning. In addition to technical advancements, the development efforts were very focused on enhancing the player's perspective. Producer Wu Bing-yu notes: "There was definitely a lot of pressure leading up to Next Fest, but this is a great place for games to get some exposure. We're going to compete with a variety of outstanding games and receive feedback from players around the world. It's not only a great test for the game, it's a great test for the team too. "

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/472597357082dd11f6fe56e3a0e908eb0bc23788.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/b8df68540523ead6e0fd974d42b9bdd0c8411d1e.png[/img]

Steam's Next Fext will run from 10/9 to 10/16 (Pacific Time), lasting for one full week. During this time, players can download and play The Extrication. The development team will also collect feedback for game adjustments and optimizations, making the finished game even more intricate and layered. The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication will officially launch next year.

notes.title: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication
notes.notes:
Given Softstar's success in adapting the film The Bridge Curse into the 2022 survival horror game The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation, players have been eagerly waiting for its sequel, The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication. Following the launch of the game's Steam page, the first promo video has been officially released, giving players a peek at Wen Hua University's "Carnival of Horror."

[previewyoutube=EkzjUDD5WT8;full][/previewyoutube]

The promo starts with the image of an elevator at Wen Hua University. What looks like your average college campus is soon disturbed by the last known images of a missing student, seen from the perspective of the elevator's surveillance footage. Then there's the eerie red liquid spattered on the ground and the constant rumors of ghosts haunting the campus at night... All of this unveiling a series of most mysterious and frightening incidents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/efa05b9283595d2666c1bcfb79fb9311142a209d.jpg[/img]

The game is played from a first-person perspective, and the player pieces together the story by switching between four main characters. Besides university students, part of the game is played as a reporter who arrives on campus to investigate a bizarre missing persons case after receiving an eerie letter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/b4c79b1138dcbb744defbe4ff4d5fada72932431.jpg[/img]

In the depths of night, the ticking of a clock echoes through the empty Da Ren building. A sergeant donning black shades patrols the campus after hours, and yellowing newspapers with frightening headlines can be seen crumpled in the corners. Will the school's dark secrets, after all these years, finally see the light of day?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/6066b6400a988c914e94bc9a93ac85deda13292e.png[/img]

There's an old photo of the university's ribbon-cutting ceremony, with the school founder and several esteemed guests. But it looks like one of their faces has been purposefully scratched off. Is this just the work of trouble-making students, or is someone trying to hide something…?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/31acdb6d770763bd7258827d0738e2871aa7221b.jpg[/img]

Who's that man with the creepy smile? And that woman... it looks like her head is about to fall off. Will prayer beads be enough to keep the evil away, or is this much too sinister? The complicated, interweaving storylines and the intricate visual clues scattered throughout the game show how much time and effort the development team has put into The Extrication. Softstar has also noted that besides adding new types of gameplay, the sequel is guaranteed to be even more challenging than the original, and will tell a deeper, more layered story.

notes.title: Wails and shrieks have summoned...The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication STEAM page
notes.notes:
Following the success of Softstar's adaptation of the film The Bridge Curse into the 2022 survival horror game The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation, players were screaming for a sequel. The game not only got a Gold Medal for Taiwanese Developed Games at the 2022 Taipei Game Show, it also stacked high in sales and garnered positive praise from players. After months of keeping their lips sealed, the developers are finally ready to reveal some highlights from the second game in The Bridge Curse series. The standalone sequel will be called The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication... and the STEAM page is officially open!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/f0aa928d68f58dd94ba02f4bab583a4dbb0d7477.png[/img]

The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication is a reimagined adaptation of the movie The Bridge Curse 2: Ritual, centering its plot around paranormal events that occur on a modern campus. The story takes place at Wen Hua University, known around the island for its creepy ghost stories. At the campus' supposedly haunted Da Ren building, a group of students from the film club is about to hold the "Carnival of Horror," hoping to attract some new members. They plan on re-enacting a bizarre case that happened on campus decades ago and turning it into a horror movie, but as they film in the depths of night, a series of strange events start to occur...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/2bbbaa1dfdefbf76982e3654b837adda898eb6f6.png[/img]

Just at this time, a reporter arrives on campus hoping to solve a mysterious missing persons case from the past, driven by curiosity and the prospect of an exclusive after receiving a creepy letter. The story of the students and the reporter become inextricably intertwined, and after collecting a series of clues... Will the truth be brought to light? Or does a more sinister conspiracy lie lurking in the dark? Perhaps you'll find out... if you manage to stay alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/8a00f202d7bbbfaa9f442075e871ce064f160bcd.png[/img]

The game immerses the player in a suspenseful, fright-filled story, where they control four characters from a first-person perspective. As the storyline progresses, the player follows these characters as they explore the unknown with bated breath. Besides hiding from ghastly ghouls, the player must also collect clues to unravel a thrilling mystery. Finally, The Bridge Curse 2 not only adds new items and stages, it also adds a new element to the Exploration phases of the game, as well as other functions. Who knows? Perhaps players who dig deep into the darkness will unearth even more of the horrifying truth…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/2eca1e9afd1a8f15d84726bf16b860356d11731f.png[/img]

The development team has stated that "our horror games don't solely focus on violence and gore like many Western titles. Besides freaking out the players, we also add humor and some gentler moments so that the experience isn't overly oppressive." What's more, there's quite a lot of Easter eggs waiting to be uncovered! Thanks to exceptionally meticulous storytelling and the use of realistic environments and architecture, the developers allow players to truly experience a modern campus ghost story that is infused with local culture and compelling folk superstitions.
